title: Dish
description: Dish object. Expected to use the currency of the parent object.

id.description: The dish identifier, required to resolve the associated dish details. Should be recognized by both the Platform and the Business.

price.description: Unit price in ISO 4217 minor units.

media.description: Dish media assets (e.g., dish images, preparation videos). First item is the featured media for presentation in food ordering surfaces.

modifications.description: List of modifications associated with the dish.

note.description: Buyer-specified freeform note associated with the dish.
